#!/bin/bash
set -u
if : > /root-write-test; then
  printf 'confinement failure: chroot root is writable\n' >&2
  exit 73
fi
if ! : > /var/lib/inventory/.write-probe; then
  printf 'startup failure: inventory data directory is not writable\n' >&2
  exit 74
fi
printf 'pid=%s\nstatus=running\n' "$$" > /var/lib/inventory/worker.state
trap 'printf "pid=%s\nstatus=stopped\n" "$$" > /var/lib/inventory/worker.state; exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do
  printf '%(%s)T pid=%s heartbeat\n' -1 "$$" >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
  /usr/bin/sleep 20 &
  wait $!
done
